name: sure_vl_internal_visual_proxy_reference_v1

prompt.style: VL-Calibration-inspired visual evidence then answer then dual integer reports; no reasoning/thinking
prompt.visual_encoding: free text in <vision>, no predeclared facts
prompt.confidence_scale: integers 0 through 10; divide by 10 for scoring
prompt.visual_confidence_event: teacher-grounded internal visual certainty proxy S

implementation_notes: VL-Calibration provides the visual/answer/report structure and 0-10 integer grid. Sure-VL adapts its visual target to internal teacher-grounded certainty and its answer target to unconditional correctness; generated thinking is disabled.
The published dataset supplies official QA only. Build and freeze distinct paired images, accepted-answer manifests and split identities; factual visual labels are not required by the proxy method.
The paper reports max_pixels=1000000; official code config uses 4194304. This reference chooses the published paper value.

The official launcher points at separate train.jsonl and val.jsonl placeholders, but both use the Hugging Face train split selector; prepare independent Sure-VL splits rather than copying those paths.
reference_policy_kl_coef is the official policy/reference KL setting, not Sure-VL's student/privileged-teacher distillation coefficient.
